purpose: Split-before-construction metadata control within an antigen collection; not unseen-peptide binding prediction
cohort: VDJdb2023-06-01 strict human TRB MHCI score>=1
retention: maximum closed within-HLA known-positive-excluding assignment separately in each receptor fold
common_population: all samplers on same retained positives within each fold seed; cohort differs across fold seeds
training: onehot fit only training folds; C1 liblinear tol1e-8; no receptor sequence for antigen models
uncertainty: mean of fold-seed metrics then SD/range across negative-sampling seeds; not population CI
protocol_note: Original global-construction-then-crossfit retained as separate sensitivity because exact global marginals couple complementary fold label imbalances

annotation_sensitivity.policy: Remove rows from every cohort and exclusion reference, without recoding; regenerate receptor folds
annotation_sensitivity.comparison_scope: Sensitivity to two flagged source labels, not comprehensive allele nomenclature validation
